    car = metrics.get("CAR") or metrics.get("car") or metrics.get("overall_car")
    tsr = metrics.get("TSR") or metrics.get("tsr") or metrics.get("overall_tsr")
    # Check nested
    if car is None:
        for k, v in metrics.items():
            if isinstance(v, dict):
                car = v.get("CAR") or v.get("car") or v.get("overall_car")
                tsr = v.get("TSR") or v.get("tsr") or v.get("overall_tsr")
                if car is not None:
                    break
    return car, tsr

# Print ALL experiments that have eval metrics
print("=== ALL EXPERIMENTS WITH CAR METRICS ===\n")
for eid, e in sorted(exps.items(), key=lambda x: x[1].get("created_at", "")):
    m = e.get("metrics", {})
    car, tsr = get_car_tsr(m)
    if car is not None:
        created = e.get("created_at", "")[:10]
        hyp = e.get("hypothesis", "")[:150]
        print(f"{eid}")
        print(f"  CAR={car}, TSR={tsr}, created={created}")
        print(f"  hyp: {hyp}")
        print()
